name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Starcrossed
description: Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Starcrossed edition is modeled after the armor worn by Yuri Ilyin in the famous 25th century vid, Coramor, which inspired the eponymous lovers' festival.
